title: The seven-eighths zero-free half-plane
exact_target: Do all Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, and all finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)) have no zeros in $Re(s)>7/8$, allowing a pole at one for the principal character?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Do all Dirichlet L-functions, including zeta, and all finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(sqrt(-3)) have no zeros in $Re(s)>7/8$, allowing a pole at one for the principal character?

\subsection{Short English statement}
